_comment: SuperNetFlow application vocabulary, from the application_category and application values seen over one day (task 3). 'benign': a recognised kind of normal use that explains periodic traffic. 'neutral': too generic to explain anything (plain browsing, CDNs, downloads). 'remote_access': remote desktop or remote access, which explains the traffic but is itself an exposure. 'privacy_vpn': VPNs and privacy relays (Apple Private Relay, Mozilla VPN, OpenVPN), which hide destinations but do not open the host to outside access. 'unknown': no label. Infrastructure labels name a cloud, CDN or ad network rather than an app, so they explain nothing. The site's own organisation label is treated as infrastructure via ORG_NAME.
